name: Chataka Pataka Tangy Tomato
ingredients_raw: Rice meal (42%), edible vegetable oil (palmolein, rice bran), corn meal (13%), chickpea flour, sugar, edible common salt, dehydrated vegetable powder (tomato (0.8%), onion, garlic), chilli powder, anticaking agent (ins 551), emulsifier (ins 414), flavour enhancer (ins 627, ins 631), natural & nature identical flavouring substances (tomato).
